basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast and martial arts hobbyist living in Portland, Oregon. I recently got into bourbon tasting and I'm loving the journey so far. I work as a junior software developer and enjoy sharing tips and tricks related to mobile games. In my free time, you can find me experimenting with new recipes, exploring local distilleries, or practicing Muay Thai. I'm single and typically online during the late evenings, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies primarily in the tech world. I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working as a software developer for the past year. My interest in bourbon started as a casual hobby during the lockdown, and I've been learning through online forums and local tastings. I also have some background in martial arts, having practiced Muay Thai for several years.
